generalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should furnish the copy of the certificate of registration issued by state/ central Govt.
The Intending bidder are advised to visit the site of work and also access the tender documents well in advance.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The TENDER PROCEESING FEE will not be refunded
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.

The requisite earnest money deposit (EMD) through online only with validity of 225 days from the last date of Receipt of Tenders. The tender schedule will be issued to the applicants who make payment through ONLINE only.
Earnest money Deposit(EMD) can also be submitted As per circular No.FD5Expenditure-12/2023 Dt:10.02.2023, in the form e-Bank Guarantee

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original documents for verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in Karnataka Public Procurement Portal within 3 days of opening of technical Bid

Further particulars, if any, required by the bidders can be had from the office of the ExecutiveEngineer,CNNL, KRSM & MIP Division, malavally during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the calendar of any event mentioned above happen to be General Holiday / Declared holiday, the next working day will hold good for the respective events.

The intending contractors should note that, if any of the lands (either in part/parts or in whole) required for the work is not yet acquired by the Nigama, it shall be the responsibility of the contractor to take possession of such land by consent of the owners before commencement of work. Cost of Land acquitision will be reimbursed as per actuals in line with the prevailing law.
Defect liability period is THREE YEARS from the date of completion of the entire work, after issuing of work completion certificate from CNNL.
Tenderers/Joint Venture shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.
The Tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company/Joint Venture with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc.

The application made by the firm / company/Joint Venture shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case the Tenderer should furnish a copy of power of attorney shall be submitted.
The scanned signature of the bidders / authorized representatives of the bidders shall be attached while uploading the Bid document.

Necessary certificates should be signed by an officer not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or equivalent competent authority and should be countersigned by the superior officer not below the rank of Superintending Engineer or equivalent competent authority.
The intending Bidder/firm/company/Joint Venture should furnish list of man power available with him for taking up above work.

The intending Bidder/firm/company/Joint Venture shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or on going under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the preceding five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)

The intending Bidder/firm/company/Joint Venture shall provide the audited balance sheets or other financial statements acceptable to the employer for the last five (2021-22 to 2025-26)and must demonstrate the current soundness of the applicants financial position and indicate its prospective long term profitability. If deemed necessary the employer shall have the authority to make enquiries with the applicants bankers
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate
Employees provident fund registration certificate along with copy of recent paid challan is to be furnished.

Employees Provident fund Registration Certificate (a) In respect of Contractors who are not registered with the EPF (Employees Provident Fund) authorities, the contractors should produce an undertaking that he shall within 7 days of the close of every month submit to the Executive Engineer, CNNL KRSM & MIP Division Malavalli, a statement showing the recoveries of contributions in respect of employees employed are through in and shall also furnish under the provision of the scheme to the commissioner, EPF. (b) However, having given an undertaking to this effect if the contractor does not furnish the information, the Nigama will deduct the necessary amount from the amount due from the contractor. Notwithstanding the above, the contractor will be liable for any consequential penalty /damages levied by the EPF authorities.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before attending the pre- bid meeting and also before submitting the tenders.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders.

The rates quoted by the contractor must be inclusive of all Taxes, etc.,(excluding GST). The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor.
Applicable GST will be paid separately as per the prevailing Govt Orders from time to time
Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Materials like steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL before use in this work

The work includes all lead and lift / delift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per Indian road congress and all relevant Indian codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height.

If CNNL wishes to engage third party consultants / PMC for quality control assessment, apart from the CNNL quality control and field tests, the contractor should co-operate with both Quality control authorities and the third party

Performance security:Within 20 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance, successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5.00% of the contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders (If quoted below) in accordance with the clause 25. 5 of ITT and clause 43 of the conditions of the contract.Cash/ Bankers cheque/ Demand draft/ Payorder/ Bank Guarantee in favour of ExecutiveEngineer,CNNL, KRSM & MIP Division, malavally payable at Malavally or specified small saving instruments pledged to KRSM & MIP Division,Malavally.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the expiry of the defect liability period.

Structures and other construction workers welfare cess:The contractor shall subscribe 1.00% of gross amount of each bill payable to him in respect of contract to the building and other construction workers welfare cess as per GO No: LD 300 LET 2006, Bangalore, dated: 18-01-2007. The amount of subscription will be recovered out of payable amount to him in each bill. This component is deemed to have been included in the quoted rate / Item rate .
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.
Sub leasing /subcontracting in any form is prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Subleasing/subcontracting are liable for rejection.

The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard.

On account of restrictions on sand mining and scarcity of availability of sand,as an alternative the use of manufactured sand (M-sand)confirming to relevant IS specifications may be allowedduring the remodeling work

The rates includes all leads and lifts and work shall be carried out as per the instruction of Engineer-in-charge .All specifications are as per relevant IS codes in vogue and Indian Road Congress. The rates for the specification in the Schedule-B includes all lead and Liftsirrespective of the distance and height,no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts.
The contractor should have capacity of deploying centralized batching plant along with The transit mixture during execution of concrete works for both structures and lining.

Successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of acceptance, Failure of the successful tenderer to comply with the requirements shall constitute sufficient grounds for cancellation of the award and forfeiture of the Earnest money deposit
Related to qualification condition No :2, Idle charges for men & machineries for non-progress period delayed due to any reasons attributed to the contractor will not be paid.
As per FD GO dated 26.03.2019, NSIC exemption for EMD is not accepted.
CNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons
Typo graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor
The undersigned reserves the right to either postpone or to cancel the entire process of tender
Tenderers/Joint ventures shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.

Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable. The number of members in a Joint Venture would be limited to 3(three). To be eligible to participate in the tender process, the Tenderer may be a single business entity (Business Entity) ie, Individual/Partnership Firm/ Company/ Public Sector Undertaking should be registered class-I Civil Contractor in KPWD/CPWD having suitable Technical, Financial and Managerial Capabilities are eligible to participate. (Documentary proof shall be uploaded).

Joint venture:Tendering by a joint venture of Contractors is permissible subject to following conditions (a) If the Applicant comprises a number of firms combining their resources in a joint venture, the legal entity constituting the joint venture and the individual partners in the joint venture shall be registered and shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by GoK. (b) The Lead Partner shall have minimum 51percent Financial Annual Turnover criteria and the other Members should have achieved at least 25percent of prescribed annual turnover (qualification criteria), in any of the 2 financial years during the last 5 years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26). (c)In case of Joint Venture, the eligibility criteria will be considered on the basis of combined resources. The individual firms, agencies, and joint ventures who meet the above eligibility requirements are here referred to as Each Bidder / Firm/ Company /Joint Venture. However, JV members shall nominate the partner who meets the qualification criteria under a and b above as Lead Member of the JV (d) The joint venture must satisfy collectively the Qualification criteria. For this purpose the following data of member of the joint venture may be Jointly and collectively to meet the qualifying criteria:(i) Annual turnover (sub clause 3.2 a) (ii) Similar nature of work and Quantities executed (sub clause 3.2 b & c) (iii) Financial means (sub clause 3.3 b & 3.6) (iv) Personnel capabilities (sub clause 3.3 c). (v) Equipment capabilities (sub clause 3.3a).

Each partner must satisfy the following criteria individually:1) General construction experience for the period of years stated in bid document 2) Adequate sources to meet financial commitments on the other contracts (sub clause 3.3b&3.6) 3) Financial Soundness (Instructions to Tenderers) 4)Litigation History (Instructions to Tenderers)

In accordance with the above, the Application shall include all related information required for individual partners in the joint venture. (e) Joint venture is allowed as per item No.2.3 above. (f)One of the partners, who is responsible for performing a key function in contract management or is executing a major component of the proposed contract, shall be nominated as being in charge during the tendering periods and, in the event of a successful tender, during contract execution. The partner in charge shall be authorized to incur liabilities and receive instructions for and on behalf of any and all partners of the joint venture this authorization shall be evidenced by submitting a power of attorney signed by legally authorized signatories of all the partners (g)All partners of the joint venture shall be legally liable, jointly and severally, during the tendering process and for the execution of the contract in accordance with the contract terms, and a statement to this effect shall be included in the authorization mentioned under Sub-Clause 2.3(f) above. To enable the above, each of the partners of the joint venture shall meet not less than 25percent of the qualifying criteria specified for Average annual turnover and Line of credit / liquid assets. All members of the joint venture must have experience in execution of similar works. (h) A copy of the Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) entered into by the partners shall be submitted with the Application Pursuant to Sub clause 2.3(f) to 2.3(g) above, the JVA shall include among other things: the JVs objectives the proposed management structure the contribution of each partner to the joint venture operations the commitment of the partners to joint and several liability for due performance recourse/sanctions within the JV in the event of default or withdrawal of any partner and arrangements for providing the required indemnities. (i) All the member should submit Audited Profit and Loss account statement certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant bearing the UDI (Unique Document Identification) number along with copy of income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished. Charted Accountants certificate without UDI (Unique Document Identification) number will not be considered. (j)The qualification of a joint venture does not necessarily qualify any of its partners to tender individually or as a partner in any other joint venture or association. In case of dissolution of a joint venture prior to the submission of tenders, any of the constituent firms may qualify if they meet all of the qualification requirements, subject to the return approval of the employer. Individual members of a dissolved joint venture may participate as subcontractor to qualified applicants, subject to the provisions mentioned below: No firm can be a subcontractor while submitting a tender individually or as a partner of a joint venture in the same tendering process. A firm, if acting in the capacity of subcontractor in any tender, may participate in more than one tender, but only in that capacity. A tenderer who submits, or participates in, more than one tender will cause all the proposals in which the tender has participated to be disqualified (k) The lead partner shall execute the contract with employer on behalf of JV with respect of the works if awarded to such JV. All the correspondence shall be issued in the name of Lead partner. All payments shall be made to lead partner and statutory deductions shall also made in the name of lead partner
